originals.name: Swing Gate
originals.idea: auto-attack with one pending server reply at a time; cooldown set by the server timer with a floor; transient refusals retry after a fixed interval, other refusals stop
originals.keep: one pending reply; server-set cooldown with floor; transient vs final refusal classes
originals.change: a pending swing keeps its action id so a timeout cannot send a second swing; every refusal shows a short HUD line

originals.name: Ring Stream
originals.idea: zone props load by annulus with unload slack, nearest-first queue and an in-flight cap
originals.keep: annulus test, load and unload with slack, nearest-first queue, cap
originals.change: zone cells are data; cap is a per-frame millisecond budget

originals.name: Status Stack
originals.idea: one status enum drives both movement and the HUD for states such as stun, blind, poison and frozen
originals.change: first set of six statuses, each with icon and sound; no glow state without a handler

originals.keep: pool value, maximum and state flag
originals.change: our own name and a regeneration rule earned in fights, not on a timer

defects: Swing timeout (SWGCombatSubsystem.cpp:361-368) resends without checking whether the first swing landed; a late first reply is then ignored; possible double swing. Fix: keep the action id, wait longer, or dedupe by action count on the server.
Refusals only logged (cpp:468-476). Fix: a short HUD line per refusal.
UpdateStreaming scans a square of cells per tier per call; PumpPlaceQueue copies and sorts the whole queue per call (cpp:348-379). Fix: heap for the queue and a per-frame cap on work.
